name: Spain
visa_name: Spain Digital Nomad Visa (Ley de Startups)
tax_notes: Special Beckham Law regime applies: flat 24% tax rate up to €600,000 for up to 5 years.
key_requirements: Non-EEA/EU citizens
Proof of remote work for at least 3 months for companies outside Spain
Clean criminal background check apostilled
Private health insurance valid in Spain
Degree or 3+ years relevant work experience

name: Portugal
tax_notes: Replaced NHR with IFICI program; progressive tax rates otherwise unless qualifying for specific talent schemes.
key_requirements: Remote contract or freelance contracts outside Portugal
Bank balance showing at least 12 months minimum income (~€39,000+)
NIF tax number and Portuguese bank account
1-year lease agreement or accommodation proof
Travel / Private health insurance

name: Thailand
tax_notes: Foreign-sourced income remitted in the same tax year is subject to Thai personal tax; funds remitted in later years or kept offshore generally tax-exempt.
key_requirements: Proof of 500,000 THB in bank account
Employment contract or freelance portfolio as a remote worker
Or enrollment in Muay Thai / Thai cooking / medical treatment
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

name: Japan
tax_notes: Exempt from local Japanese income taxes under bilateral tax treaties for stays under 6 months.
key_requirements: Citizen of 49 designated visa-waiver countries (US, UK, EU, etc.)
Annual income of 10M JPY (~$68k USD) or higher
Private medical insurance covering up to 10M JPY
Spouse and children can accompany

name: Greece
tax_notes: 50% income tax deduction for up to 7 years if transferring tax residence to Greece.
key_requirements: Proof of €3,500/month stable remote earnings
Clean criminal record
Medical certificate & international health insurance
Rental lease in Greece

name: Croatia
tax_notes: 100% exempt from Croatian income tax on remote work income.
key_requirements: Third-country national (non-EU/EEA)
Bank statements showing 12 months funds (~€30k) or monthly income proof
Must exit for 6 months after 1-year permit before reapplying
Full health insurance & local address registration (OIB)

name: Mexico
tax_notes: Income earned entirely outside Mexico from non-Mexican employers is generally not taxed unless Mexican tax residency is triggered.
key_requirements: Proof of financial solvency (last 6-12 months bank statements)
In-person interview at Mexican consulate outside Mexico
Exchange visa for Canje card at INM within 30 days of arrival

name: Costa Rica
visa_name: Costa Rica Estancia Visa for Remote Workers (Law 10008)
tax_notes: Complete exemption from Costa Rican income tax, import tax on equipment, and duty on vehicles.
key_requirements: Proof of $3,000 USD monthly income over the past 12 months
Medical insurance covering entire stay ($50k coverage min)
Application submitted via Tramite Ya portal

name: United Arab Emirates (Dubai)
visa_name: Dubai Remote Work Visa (Virtual Working Programme)
tax_notes: 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax.
key_requirements: Proof of employment with 1-year contract validity or business ownership
Last month salary slip and 3 months bank statements
Health insurance with UAE coverage

name: Georgia
tax_notes: Individual Entrepreneur Small Business Status offers 1% flat turnover tax up to ~180k USD.
key_requirements: 365-day visa-free entry for US, EU, and many other passports
Simple border run resets the 365-day counter
Health insurance recommended

name: Malta
tax_notes: Flat 10% income tax on income derived from authorized nomad work, avoiding local standard progressive rates.
key_requirements: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss national
Employment contract outside Malta or remote freelance business
Proof of €42,000 annual gross income
Valid rental lease agreement or property purchase in Malta
All-risk health insurance coverage valid across Schengen

name: Cyprus
tax_notes: Not considered tax resident if spending under 183 days; non-dom tax scheme available for tax residents (0% tax on dividends/interest).
key_requirements: Non-EU/EEA national working for overseas clients
Proof of €3,500 net monthly income (+20% for spouse, +15% per child)
Clean criminal record and apostilled police certificate
Adequate private medical insurance
Local residential lease contract in Cyprus

name: Italy
visa_name: Italy Digital Nomad Visa (Visto Nomadi Digitali)
tax_notes: Special regime for freelancers (Regime Forfettario) offers 5% flat substitute tax for first 5 years up to €85,000 turnover.
key_requirements: Highly qualified professional (degree or accredited license)
At least 6 months proven remote work experience
Tax compliance proof in home country
Comprehensive health insurance policy covering €30,000+
Residential contract / lease in Italy

name: Estonia
tax_notes: Tax residency triggered after 183 days. 20% flat personal tax rate; e-Residency corporate income 0% on reinvested profits.
key_requirements: Employed by a non-Estonian employer or running location-independent business
Income threshold verified via last 6 months bank statements
Travel medical insurance covering at least €30,000 for entire stay
Written explanation of remote work nature

name: Hungary
tax_notes: 15% flat personal income tax. Tax exempt in Hungary for first 183 days if tax resident elsewhere.
key_requirements: Third-country non-EEA citizen
Employed by an employer outside Hungary or owns foreign company shares
Cannot pursue gainful employment for Hungarian entities
Comprehensive health insurance and verified Budapest rental lease

name: Czech Republic
tax_notes: Pausalni Dan (Lump-sum tax) allows paying flat monthly amount (~CZK 7,500/mo) covering tax, social, and healthcare.
key_requirements: Zivnostensky List (Czech Trade License) registration
Proof of sufficient funds in personal bank account
Proof of accommodation for 1 full year
Comprehensive foreign health insurance (PVZP or equivalent)
Apostilled clean police clearance

name: Latvia
tax_notes: Reduced 15% flat PIT rate available for qualifying digital nomad visa holders.
key_requirements: Citizen of OECD or NATO member country
Contract with employer registered in OECD country for at least 6 months
Proof of 2.5x Latvian average gross wage
Valid health insurance policy with Schengen coverage

name: Romania
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign-earned income for the first 183 consecutive days; exempt from local social security contributions.
key_requirements: Employed by or owning a foreign company for at least 3 years
Proof of income 3x national gross average for past 6 months
Clean criminal record and proof of accommodation
Medical insurance valid in Romania covering €30,000+

name: Albania
tax_notes: Special tax holiday offering 0% corporate tax for tech startups and minimal tax burden for non-resident remote freelancers.
key_requirements: Valid foreign work or service contract
Bank statements showing steady $1,200/mo income
Local residential rental lease in Albania
Valid travel medical insurance

name: Montenegro
tax_notes: Income tax exemption for digital nomads under specific residency programs, or flat 9% personal income tax rate.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign enterprise or proof of freelance service clients
Proof of funds (€1,350/mo minimum)
Rental contract in Montenegro
Clean criminal record and international health insurance

name: Iceland
min_monthly_income_local: 1,000,000 ISK/mo (~$7,500 USD) or 1.3m ISK for couples
tax_notes: Exempt from local taxation during the 180-day stay; remains tax resident in home country.
key_requirements: Non-EEA/EFTA citizen from visa-exempt nation
Letter from foreign employer or remote business ownership proof
Demonstrated 1,000,000 ISK monthly income
Full travel medical insurance covering Iceland

name: Germany
min_monthly_income_local: Adequate funds to cover living costs (~€10,000 in bank balance)
tax_notes: Progressive tax rate (14% - 42%). Basic personal tax allowance (~€11,784) is completely tax-free.
key_requirements: Qualified liberal profession (coder, designer, journalist, consultant)
Letters of intent from prospective German or international clients
Proof of professional qualification / portfolio
German-compliant statutory or expat health insurance
Registered residential address (Anmeldung)

name: Colombia
visa_name: Colombia Digital Nomad Visa (Visa V Nómadas Digitales)
tax_notes: No tax liability on foreign-earned income if staying under 183 days within any 365-day rolling period.
key_requirements: Valid contract with foreign enterprise or entrepreneurial activities
Bank statements showing 3 months minimum wage equivalent
Health insurance with international coverage for entire stay
Valid passport with at least 2 blank pages

name: Brazil
min_monthly_income_local: $1,500/mo income or $18,000 lump sum bank balance
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign income if staying under 183 days. Progressive rates (up to 27.5%) apply if staying longer.
key_requirements: Proof of remote employment outside Brazil
Monthly income of $1,500+ or $18,000 bank balance
Clean criminal record check from home country
Valid health insurance policy covering Brazilian territory

name: Argentina
min_monthly_income_local: Demonstrated income covering local cost of living (~$1,200/mo)
tax_notes: Foreign remote income is exempt from Argentine taxes during the temporary nomad stay.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign employer or freelance invoicing history
Proof of professional qualification and curriculum vitae
Valid travel medical insurance covering Argentina
Valid passport from visa-exempt nation

name: Uruguay
tax_notes: Territorial tax system: foreign-sourced active income earned outside Uruguay is 100% tax-free.
key_requirements: Complete online application after entering Uruguay on tourist visa
Signed affidavit confirming remote work outside Uruguay
Clean criminal record and vaccination certificate
Valid passport and international medical insurance

name: Ecuador
visa_name: Ecuador Digital Nomad Visa (Visa Rentista Nómada)
tax_notes: Income earned exclusively from foreign sources is not subject to Ecuadorian personal income tax.
key_requirements: Official remote employment contract or corporate ownership
Bank statements showing 3x basic salary for past 3 months
Police record certificate apostilled or legalized
Health insurance with coverage in Ecuador

name: Panama
visa_name: Panama Short Stay Remote Worker Visa
tax_notes: Strict territorial tax system: income generated outside Panama is completely free from local taxation.
key_requirements: Letter from foreign employer or self-employed company documents
Bank statements showing $3,000/mo minimum foreign income
Medical insurance policy covering Panama
Sworn declaration of non-acceptance of employment in Panama

name: Belize
visa_name: Belize Work Where You Vacation Program
tax_notes: Exempt from personal income taxes and business taxes on all remote foreign earnings.
key_requirements: Proof of foreign employment or business ownership
Proof of $75,000 USD annual income
Clean police record and international health insurance ($50k coverage)
Valid travel passport

name: Barbados
tax_notes: Exempt from local personal income tax under the Welcome Stamp legislation.
key_requirements: Remote work contract outside Barbados
Attestation of earning at least $50,000/year
Valid passport and passport-sized photo
Full health insurance coverage for the duration of stay

name: Bahamas
tax_notes: Bahamas imposes 0% personal income tax, 0% corporate tax, and 0% capital gains tax.
key_requirements: Letter of employment from foreign employer or remote business proof
Proof of sufficient financial means to maintain stay
Valid medical insurance policy covering the Bahamas
Clean criminal record check

name: Bermuda
min_monthly_income_local: Continuous remote income source and sufficient means
tax_notes: 0% income tax in Bermuda; certificate holders pay zero payroll taxes.
key_requirements: Remote worker or university student studying remotely
Proof of employment or company ownership outside Bermuda
Continuous source of annual income
Mandatory health insurance coverage

name: Antigua & Barbuda
tax_notes: 0% personal income tax in Antigua and Barbuda on worldwide income.
key_requirements: Employed outside Antigua or self-employed with international clients
Proof of earning at least $50,000/year
Police clearance certificate for applicants over 16
Comprehensive health insurance policy

name: Dominica
tax_notes: No personal income tax liability on foreign-sourced earnings under the WIN program.
key_requirements: Proof of foreign employment or remote enterprise
Anticipated annual income of $50,000+
Police record check and medical health certificate
Valid health insurance policy covering Dominica

name: Curaçao
tax_notes: Remote workers are not considered tax residents and pay 0% income tax on foreign income.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign enterprise or freelance clientele
Proof of adequate financial means
International travel and medical insurance
Confirmed return flight ticket and accommodation booking

name: Indonesia
tax_notes: E33G visa provides 100% tax exemption on foreign remote income remitted from abroad.
key_requirements: Official employment contract with overseas company outside Indonesia
Bank balance showing at least $2,000 USD
Proof of $60,000 annual salary ($5,000/mo)
Passport with at least 6 months validity

name: Malaysia
tax_notes: Foreign-sourced remote income earned while living in Malaysia is exempt from Malaysian personal income tax.
key_requirements: Digital freelancer or remote worker in IT/digital tech domains
Minimum annual income of $24,000 USD
Active client or employment contracts outside Malaysia
Valid passport and personal health insurance

name: Taiwan
tax_notes: 50% tax deduction on salary income above NT$3,000,000 for the first 5 years of residency.
key_requirements: Expert in economy, science, tech, education, finance, or culture
Proven monthly income of NT$160,000 in previous employment
4-in-1 combo card: work permit, resident visa, alien resident certificate, re-entry permit
Comprehensive health check upon arrival

name: South Korea
tax_notes: Workation visa holders performing tasks for foreign employers pay 0% Korean tax on remote foreign income.
key_requirements: Employed by overseas company for at least 1 year in same industry
Annual income exceeding 2x previous year's Bank of Korea GNI per capita
Clean criminal record check apostilled
Private medical insurance with coverage of at least 100,000,000 KRW

name: Philippines
visa_name: Philippines Special Resident Retiree / Remote Permit
min_monthly_income_local: Affordable living proof ($1,500/mo) or 3-year renewable tourist extensions
tax_notes: Non-resident aliens pay 0% tax on income sourced outside the Philippines.
key_requirements: Valid foreign employment or freelance contracts
Proof of sufficient remote earnings to maintain stay
Travel and medical insurance covering Philippine territory
Clean police certificate and valid passport

name: Sri Lanka
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign currency earnings remitted to Sri Lanka through authorized banking channels.
key_requirements: Proof of $2,000/mo income channelled through commercial banking accounts
Employment or freelance contracts with entities outside Sri Lanka
Clean police check and return flight ticket
Valid international travel health insurance

name: Türkiye
tax_notes: Foreign remote work earnings generally free from local personal income taxes if staying under 183 days.
key_requirements: Citizen of designated eligible countries (age 21-55)
University degree diploma
Contract with company located outside Türkiye
Proof of $3,000 monthly income and valid medical insurance

name: Mauritius
tax_notes: Money spent in Mauritius using foreign credit/debit cards is not taxed; 15% flat tax applies only if money is remitted into local accounts after 183 days.
key_requirements: Produce proof of long-stay travel plans and accommodation
Proof of funds ($1,500/mo remote income)
Do not enter Mauritius labor market
Full travel and health insurance policy

name: Cape Verde
tax_notes: 0% income tax on remote earnings under the official Cabo Verde Nomad statute.
key_requirements: Citizen from Europe, North America, PALOP, or ECOWAS
Bank balance showing steady €1,500/mo income for past 6 months
Health insurance with repatriation coverage
Booking of local accommodation

name: South Africa
tax_notes: Exempt from registering with SARS for South African personal taxes if staying under 6 months within 12 months.
key_requirements: Employed by foreign entity with contract
Proof of annual gross income exceeding R650,000
Police clearance and medical radiology report
Comprehensive international medical insurance

name: Namibia
tax_notes: No local income taxes incurred on remote earnings during the 6-month stay.
key_requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside Namibia
6 months bank statements demonstrating $2,000/mo income
Valid medical insurance for stay duration
Clean police certificate and medical report

name: Seychelles
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign earnings under the Workcation Visitors Work Permit.
key_requirements: Valid foreign remote employment letter or commercial ownership
Proof of adequate funds for living on islands
Valid travel medical insurance covering Covid/emergency care
Confirmed accommodation booking in certified establishment
